title: Design: Customer page on a phone shows Bill Invoices To and Change on one line
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Use a phone, or a browser window 390 pixels wide, signed in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have customer A (it pays for others) and customer B, with customer A saved as customer B's Bill Invoices To in Edit Customer.
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p1-26-after-phone.png, bt-p1-25-before-phone.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The card shows the bold label "Bill Invoices To" under IBS.
  • Customer A's name and a blue "Change" sit on one line under it, as in the picture.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12303 (Story 1, Saved default Bill To on the customer page)

  • S1-R1: “When a default other than the customer itself is saved, the customer page left card shows "Bill Invoices To" with the payer's name.”
  • S1-R2: “Users who may set the default see "Change" beside the name; it opens the "Bill Invoices To" window.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: page "1 Set a customer's default Bill To", pictures "Phone" (This build), "Phone" (Production (v26.45.2.1)).

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • bt-p1-26-after-phone.png
  • bt-p1-25-before-phone.png

The design's own words:

  • “The same "Bill Invoices To" line with "Change", under IBS. Nothing phone-only.”
